content.short: Orbis Club helps build decentralized social experiences with Orbis Protocol.
content.description: Orbis Club is built on a suite of social data models paired with a robust decentralized infrastructure, empowering developers to craft fully composable social experiences. The platform provides a modular SDK and flexible building blocks that make it easy to assemble feature-rich social apps. User data and content live on Ceramic, a decentralized data network, ensuring what users share remains open and publicly accessible across supported chains. Designed for developers and communities to collaborate openly.
